**First launch.** macOS will announce that it cannot verify Sidetone is free of
malware, which sounds serious right up until you remember that this app's entire
ambition is playing your microphone into your headphones.

You get two buttons: "Move to Trash" and "Done". Trash is the friendly blue one,
because Apple believes in you. Click Done.

Then open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security, and
click "Open Anyway" next to the message about Sidetone. Confirm once, and macOS
never brings it up again.

There is, for the record, no malware. Apple has not checked because being checked
costs $99 a year, which is $99 more than this app earns. Every line of it is in the
repository, and most of those lines are arithmetic about ring buffers. If I were
after your data, I would not have led with a volume slider.

[The longer version](https://github.com/MylesShannon/sidetone#if-you-downloaded-the-dmg)
